title: 2012 Mercedes-Benz C63 AMG Coupe Black Series

sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2012 Mercedes-Benz C63 AMG Black Series, finished in Diamond White with a black interior. The attached Carfax history report shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this Mercedes-Benz's past; it also lists registrations in Nevada, Oregon, and Washington from new. This C63 AMG Black Series is 1 of 800 produced worldwide for the 2012 model year. The hardcore performance-focused Black Series boasts 59 horsepower and 14 lb-ft of torque over the standard C63 AMG, thanks to a revised ECU and forged pistons, connecting rods, and a crankshaft borrowed from the SLS AMG. It looks the part, too, with enlarged fenders, a wider track, and aggressive bodywork designed to scoop in more air and keep it planted firmly on the road. Factory equipment includes 19-inch 10-spoke forged alloy wheels, adjustable coilover suspension, a limited-slip differential, a panoramic sunroof, MB-Tex and Dinamica upholstery, heated front seats, carbon fiber interior trim, a Harman/Kardon sound system, a rear-view camera, and more as detailed below. Modifications reported by the seller include a resonator delete, tinted windows, and a Passport radar detector, plus paint protection film on the front end, A-pillars, and side skirts. Power comes from a hand-built "M156" 6.2-liter V8, rated at 510 horsepower and 457 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 7-speed AMG Speedshift multi-clutch automatic transmission and a limited-slip differential.
sections.Equipment: A build sheet is provided in the photo gallery, and a partial list of notable equipment includes: Black Series Package (increased engine output to 510 horsepower, limited-slip differential lock, carbon fiber trim, bi-xenon active headlights, intelligent highbeam control, headlamp washing system, rear-view camera, twin cupholders, voice control, Comand system with hard-drive navigation, collapsible spare tire, Keyless-Go) Black Series Seating Package (4-seat configuration) 19-inch 10-spoke forged alloy wheels Adjustable coilover suspension Panoramic sunroof MB-Tex and Dinamica upholstery Power-adjustable and heated front seats with memory function Harman/Kardon sound system Automatic climate control
